description: A tall, brown wooden bookshelf with multiple shelves and two cabinets at the bottom. The top shelf holds a globe. The second shelf displays several red-spined books. The third shelf has a stack of white papers, a small black object, and more red-spined books. The fourth shelf contains two stacks of books, a small glass dome with a figure inside, and a pencil. The cabinets below have yellow knobs.
